summary: Backend-only regression after secrets refactor (admin.py now requires JWT_SECRET/ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD from env; admin import moved after load_dotenv in server.py). All 60 pytest tests pass, including admin auth (success/wrong-password/missing/tampered token), admin stats, admin products list, and the full pre-existing iteration 1-4 suite. Backend starts cleanly (no RuntimeError in current startup); GET /api/health returns 200. Added one new regression test: tampered-JWT -> 401.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py _required_env correctly fails fast with a clear message when secrets are missing; server.py imports admin after load_dotenv which is the correct fix.

Historical entries for 'RuntimeError: Missing required environment variable JWT_SECRET' remain in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log from the pre-fix reload cycle. Current uvicorn process is running cleanly ('Application startup complete') and the health endpoint returns 200 - no action needed, but the older stack traces will remain in the log file until it is rotated.
seed_data_creation: None new. Test suite creates and cleans up TEST_ prefixed products/classes/orders as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend admin secrets are now required via env (JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD). /app/backend/.env carries them. If any of these are ever unset, the backend will fail to start with a RuntimeError - check /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log first.
rca_of_issue: N/A - regression run confirmed the secrets refactor is functional; nothing to fix.
